backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping Chocolate Day UI updates to affected frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all main frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark OKLCH color variables and theme tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React SPA root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app flow switching between screens and handling No-button movement, gestures, and celebration UI.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicC: UI controls for play/pause and mute/unmute using background music context.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicP: Context provider managing a looping audio element and play/mute interactions.
frontend/src/components/DownloadZipContr: Floating button that downloads a bundled ZIP file asset.
Cover screen with hearts, teddy decorations, and button to open the note.
frontend/src/components/NehaNoteScreen.t: Note screen displaying a Chocolate Day message, illustration, and continue button.
frontend/src/components/TeddyDecor.tsx: Utility component placing floating teddy sticker images randomly on screen.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Provides a React context hook for accessing and controlling background music playback state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider for authentication, identity loading, login, and logout behaviors.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH color variables for a light/dark romantic theme.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the themed UI.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, feature requirements, and architectural notes for a romantic interactive web page.
